# Geometry

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Geometry`](gmeow-Geometry.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Geometry>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The spatial extent of a place — a point, line, or polygon — carrying a Well-Known Text (WKT) serialization for shapes richer than a single point (the GeoSPARQL [geo:Geometry](http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Geometry) superset).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

Use [`gmeow:Geometry`](gmeow-Geometry.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the spatial extent of a place richer than a point — a line or polygon — serialized as WKT or GeoJSON.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a single point (use [`GeoCoordinates`](gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md)) and avoid carrying the frame in the literal; the frame travels on the [`CoordinateObservation`](gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Mint [`Geometry`](gmeow-Geometry.md) with [`gmeow:geometryType`](../properties/gmeow-geometryType.md) and [`gmeow:asWKT`](../properties/gmeow-asWKT.md) / [`gmeow:asGeoJSON`](../properties/gmeow-asGeoJSON.md); reach it from a place via [`gmeow:hasGeometry`](../properties/gmeow-hasGeometry.md) or [`CoordinateObservation`](gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) → [`gmeow:geometryResult`](../properties/gmeow-geometryResult.md).

### Examples

- ex:shape a [`gmeow:Geometry`](gmeow-Geometry.md); [`gmeow:geometryType`](../properties/gmeow-geometryType.md) [`gmeow:geometryTypePolygon`](../individuals/gmeow-geometryTypePolygon.md); [`gmeow:asWKT`](../properties/gmeow-asWKT.md) "POLYGON((...))".
